ken: Quick cross-team ask 1 UI wants a "Dry Run" for Console saved queries: run against sampled telemetry to preview model split, cost and expected latency before saving/rolling out. thinking about surface + API. anyone object?
olga: Love it. Two product constraints: 1) must be super fast (<2s) for small samples, 2) cannot touch billing or increment per-token counters.
tia: Implementation note: we already have a light-weight sampler in telemetry; reuse it and tag results as `synthetic`. Also need a configurable `sample_rate` param so UX can select 1%, 5%, 20% windows.
oscar: API proposal (rough): ```POST /console/v1/saved_query/dry_run {"query":"...","scope":"personal|route|team","sample_rate":0.05} -> 200 {"preview_id":"pv_123","est_tokens":420,"est_cost_cents":12,"model_breakdown":[{"model":"rwd-7b-q","pct":0.7}]} ``` Important: response should include headers to show rate-limit and a flag `X-RW-SYNTHETIC: true`.
maria: RBAC: default `scope=personal` for non-admins. If someone requests `scope=route` we must verify `can_view_route` and warn that the preview will redact internal fallback reasons. Also redact dedicated/host hints to avoid exposing infra topology.
ken: UX: show an "estimated confidence" (e.g. ~10%) and a small sparkline of latency distribution. If scope=route and user lacks permissions, UI should show CTA "Request preview access" which hits an internal endpoint for route owner approval.
tia: Ops: add a sandbox tag in telemetry `meta.synthetic_preview=true` and ensure these events are excluded from billing/aggregates. We should also cap previews per-user (default 10/min) in frontdoor.
olga: Can Console do optimistic caching? If same query + scope + sample_rate repeats within 30s, return cached preview. saves infra cycles.
oscar: Good idea. Add cache key: sha256(query+scope+sample_rate+user). Also include `X-RW-PREVIEW-ID` so support can trace without leaking internal logs.
ken: Who owns end-to-end? tia for infra/telemetry, oscar for API, olga for UX, maria for permissions. I can take the console integration. Target: prototype flag behind feature-flag for next sprint.
dev-bot: branch created: dry-run-preview-proto, CI queued. :shipit:
maria: small security: ensure previews can't enumerate routes or return a list of routes for orgs users aren't part of. enforce `route_list` ACLs in server.
ken: noted. Also add a small footprint mode for mobile Console that only requests a 1% sample by default.
oscar: final API tweak: accept header `X-RW-TRACE: short` to return a compact trace for debug if the user is an admin. normal users get minimal output.
olga: OK let's do a 3-day spike: 1) API proto + telemetry flag, 2) Console mock + rate-limit UX, 3) small privacy review. tagging @tia @oscar @maria.
tia: I'll start infra spike today.
ken: thanks team. Proceed? :thumbsup:
